g.text: A motor operating point must fit the continuous torque envelope and the mechanical load

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned motor envelope, not a manufacturer torque-speed curve. Continuous limit is10 N·m to1500 rpm then constant15000 N·m·rpm; intermittent limit is1.8
times continuous. Load torque is2+8(n/3000)². Control, cooling, acceleration, and duty duration determine actual permissible operation.
